original: 吾**不知其名**，字之曰道；天法道，**道法自然**。
vernacular_zh: 我不知它的名，勉强叫它“道”；天效法道，道以它自己为法。
translation_en: I do not know its name, and I give it the designation of the Tao. ... The law of the Tao is its being what it is.

scripture.text_zh: 神对摩西说：“我是自有永有的。”因为没有比自己更大可以指着起誓的，就指着自己起誓。
scripture.text_en: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM ... because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself.
scripture.ref_zh: 出埃及记 3:14; 希伯来书 6:13

insight_zh: 老子：**不知其名**，强字曰道；神说：**我是自有永有**。
insight_en: Laozi: **I do not know its name**. God: **I AM THAT I AM**.
